verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a platform that agents reach through MCP and CLI for publishing and analytics, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens. The `--scope project` flag only chooses which agent config file gets written (project-level versus user-level); it does not limit an agent's permissions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
